sources.snippet: Problem Description In this assignment, you will use the CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training) model to perform zero-shot image classification. You will load a pre-trained CLIP model, preprocess an image and a set of text labels, and then use the model to predict the most likely label for the image.

sources.snippet: CLIP [Blog] [Paper] [Model Card] [Colab] CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training) is a neural network trained on a variety of (image, text) pairs. It can be instructed in natural language to predict the most relevant text snippet, given an image, without directly optimizing for the task, similarly to the zero-shot capabilities of GPT-2 and 3.
